title: Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.24727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid expansion of gravitational-wave astronomy and high-precision numerical relativity has created an acute computational bottleneck: direct numerical integration of the Einstein field equations and high-dimensional Bayesian parameter estimation require millions of waveform evaluations that cannot be sustained by traditional solvers alone. Reduced-order modeling (ROM) and surrogate techniques have emerged as foundational tools to bridge this gap, compressing high-fidelity solution manifolds into compact, rapidly evaluable representations without sacrificing physical accuracy. This perspective reviews the mathematical pillars of projection-based reduced-order modeling---including Proper Orthogonal Decomposition, greedy basis selection, and the Empirical Interpolation Method---and traces their operational impact in gravitational-wave data analysis through surrogate waveform families and Reduced-Order Quadratures. translated_title: 引力波物理与数值相对论中的代理建模与降阶方法：从谱表示到自适应压缩
translated_abstract: 引力波天文学的迅速发展与高精度数值相对论造成了严峻的计算瓶颈：对爱因斯坦场方程的直接数值积分以及高维贝叶斯参数估计需要数百万次波形评估，仅靠传统求解器无法持续支撑。降阶建模与代理技术已成为弥合这一差距的基础性工具，能够在不牺牲物理精度的前提下，将高保真度解流形压缩为紧凑且可快速评估的表示形式。本综述回顾了基于投影的降阶建模的数学支柱——包括本征正交分解（POD）、贪婪基选择和经验插值方法（EIM）——并通过代理波形族与降阶求积（Reduced-Order Quadratures）追踪了这些方法在引力波数据分析中的实际影响。随后我们考察了……
tldr: 该综述系统回顾了以本征正交分解、贪婪基选择和经验插值方法为核心的降阶建模与代理技术，展示其如何将高保真引力波波形压缩为可快速评估的紧凑表示，从而突破数值相对论与参数估计中的计算瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This perspective reviews the mathematical foundations of reduced-order modeling—POD, greedy basis selection, and the Empirical Interpolation Method—and demonstrates how surrogate waveforms and Reduced-Order Quadratures compress high-fidelity gravitational-wave solutions into rapidly evaluable representations to overcome computational bottlenecks.
